description: This Java class 'GuarantorHelper' provides helper methods for managing guarantors in integration tests within the Fineract project. It includes methods to create, update, delete, and retrieve guarantor information for loans via REST API calls.

classes.name: GuarantorHelper
classes.description: Helper class for operations related to guarantors in integration tests, including creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving guarantor data via REST API.

methods.name: GuarantorHelper
methods.description: Constructor initializing request and response specifications for API interactions.

methods.name: createGuarantor
methods.description: Creates a new guarantor for a specified loan using provided JSON data.

methods.name: updateGuarantor
methods.description: Updates an existing guarantor using provided JSON data.

methods.name: deleteGuarantor
methods.description: Deletes a guarantor based on guarantor ID, loan ID, and funding ID.

methods.name: deleteGuarantor
methods.description: Deletes a guarantor based only on guarantor ID and loan ID.

methods.name: getGuarantor
methods.description: Retrieves guarantor details as specified by JSON parameters.

methods.name: getAllGuarantor
methods.description: Retrieves all guarantors for a specific loan.
